title: The Monkey and the Mangoes | Fun Kids Song & Nursery Rhymes for Toddlers | BuBu TV - English
description:
A cheeky monkey grabs a basket of ripe mangoes, but a little sharing makes everyone happy!
This playful song teaches toddlers counting, colors, and the joy of sharing with friends.
Sing along and enjoy the sweet, sticky fun of mango time!

Mango, mango, sweet and sweet
yum yum here, yum yum there
nom, nom, nom, nom
the best fruit everywhere!

Papa picks the mangoes, yellow, ripe, and round
one, two, three, into the basket
plop, plop, plop, plop
yummy mangoes, all found!

Swing, swing, swing, a monkey comes
grabs the basket, off he runs
zoom, zoom, zoom, zoom
"Hey, monkey!" shout the ones!

Mango, mango, sweet and sweet
yum yum here, yum yum there
nom, nom, nom, nom
the best fruit everywhere!

Monkey's tummy grumbles, grumble, grumble
Amma says, "Let's share, it's fair!"
two for you, two for you
the monkey gives the basket back!

Mango, mango, sweet and sweet
yum yum here, yum yum there
nom, nom, nom, nom
the best fruit everywhere!

Everyone eats mangoes, sticky, sweet, and fine
juice on chins, slurp, slurp
yum, yum, yum, yum
la la la, see you next time!

la la la, la la la
la la la, la la la
